The present hypothesis addresses this level. Rumination is described as a surrogate prediction-error minimization mechanism that arises when registered sympathetic activation finds no causal explanation in the subject's generative model, while both standard routes of resolution-action and prior revision-are structurally unavailable. The key self-maintenance circuit is borrowed from the interoceptive conditioning literature: afferent feedback from the mobilization itself belongs to the same class of visceral signal as the conditioned threat predictor and reconfirms it-a loop documented in the panic spiral in its acute mode and extrapolated here to a chronic, subcatastrophic mode.
